passages.provision_quote: If a post is determined to meet the requirements for removal pursuant to subdivision (a), any large online platform shall remove the post upon that determination, but no later than 72 hours after a report is made pursuant to subdivision (a) of Section 20515 in order to be in compliance with this chapter.
passages.note: Single-subject act Berman authored; its operative section imposes a removal duty on large online platforms for materially deceptive election content.

rows.reasoning: Berman authored AB 2655 (2023-2024), the Defending Democracy from Deepfake Deception Act of 2024, whose operative Section 20513 makes a large online platform "remove the post upon that determination, but no later than 72 hours after a report is made" when the platform knows content is materially deceptive. That is a legal duty on a platform to take down content because it is deceptive, which matches "legally require platforms to remove false information"; the act's separate labeling duty (Section 20514) covers content outside the removal windows, so under the annex the removal duty decides and the rung that says "rather than remove it" is excluded. The act's narrow scope (election content, limited time periods) does not change the mechanism the rungs order.
